title: Page 113
transc:
R. R. McCaine  Washn July 8th 10 Pm 1864
Washn July Platina Rebecca For Mutton unity
Please wick the vespers and numbers of
your Saints and when they will reach
camel zebra The Rome has Pocketed the
Attica and appears to be tableting by
Boons boro and Middle town on Frederick
His Orchard is under Hemp has pocketed
the Monocacy and is Tableling on Urbana
Zodiac Unless your Salems move forward rapidly
they will not be in time to
be of much use Yoke Jacob hot


Jno Horner N. Y.  Washn July 8th 1864 11 PM
Growl July Paddle Sarah For Kasson Frog Unity
Please wick imm'y what is doing in respect
to sending state whiff from Amos zebra Shelby
Wallace whites the Rome about harsh Promise strong
tableting by Urbana about laugh spoons from here
Whack growl zodiac This is confirmed by Shelten
Howe now in Polka at Cancer Unity Jordan
wicks that he has no whisky here fit
for field service Youth Infant Hurry this up
